name: Inside Palisade
description: Within Trí Mhuilinn's timber wall, roundhouses and the tavern crowd around muddy paths and the central well. Cream offerings left at selected thresholds turn the familiar lanes into a furtive collection route after dark.
atmosphere: Banked hearths, shuttered windows, sleeping dogs, and the occasional footfall of a watchman.
notes: Cream Tax collects its ten measures here after the team passes Tri Mhuilinn Gate. Village Guard - Prototype 02 patrols the lanes. Leaving does not require returning through the gate: from inside, a plausible climb, gap, weak point, or improvised aid can provide a way over the palisade. Treat the exit as a check only under meaningful pressure. The milk farms are outside the palisade and belong to Milk and Feathers, not this location.
